name: Polignac
summary: French trick-avoidance ancestor of Hearts where players try to avoid winning Jacks, especially the Jack of Spades.
rules_text: Polignac is played with a 32-card Piquet pack ranking K Q J A T 9 8 7. For 3,5,6 players remove the black Sevens to make the deck divisible. Deal all cards evenly in packets of 2s and 3s. Eldest leads first. Players must follow suit if able, otherwise may discard any card. Highest card of led suit wins the trick and leads next. No trumps. Scoring per hand: 2 penalty points for capturing JS (Polignac) and 1 point for each other Jack. First player to reach an agreed total (10 or 20) loses. Before the first lead a player may bid capot/general to win all tricks; if successful each opponent gets 5 penalty, if failed bidder gets 5. Variant: Ace high with penalties on Queens.
rating_reason: Trick-taking avoidance, specific deck and player count, strategic
